clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope

clauses.title: Requirements of materials, dimensions,
clauses.text: 1.1 Requirements of materials, dimensions, construction, shape workmanship, performance requirements and inspection and testing of rotatiional moulded polyethylene water storage tanks with a nominal service temperature +1oC to + 50 oC.

clauses.title: These tanks are not
clauses.text: 1.1.1 These tanks are not meant for underground applications.

clauses.title: This standard is applicable
clauses.text: 1.2. This standard is applicable tanks subjected to the following conditions : a) Own hydrostatic head of water, and b) Tank with uniform flat base support . clauses.title: This standard does not
clauses.text: 1.3 This standard does not cover mobile and horizontal cylindrical water tanks

clauses.title: Material
clauses.text: 2. Material

clauses.title: Shall be such that
clauses.text: 2.1 Shall be such that it does not impart any taste, colour or odour to water, nor have any toxic effect, and it shall not contaminate water thereby making it unpotable.

clauses.title: Polyethylene resin to be
clauses.text: 2.2 Polyethylene resin to be used should be of rotational moulded grade and duly stabilized with antioxidants. The anti oxidants used, not exceeding 0.3% by mass of finished resin, should be physiologically harmless and should be selected from the list given in IS 10141: 1982. Positive list of constituents of polyethylene in contact with food stuffs, pharmaceuticals and drinking water.

clauses.title: The density of resin
clauses.text: 2.3 The density of resin (base material ) at 23 oC shall be within 932 to 943 kg/m3.

clauses.title: The melt flow rate
clauses.text: 2.4 The melt flow rate (MFR) of the resin under (Temperature 190' C and nominal load of 2.16 kg)  shall be within 2.0 to 6.0 g/10 minutes.

clauses.title: The water tanks meant
clauses.text: 2.5 The water tanks meant for out door use shall be manufactured from carbon black compounded polyethylene and shall meet the following requirements: a) The percentage of carbon black content in the materials shal be within 2.0 and 3.0,and b) The dispersion of carbon black shall be satisfactory.

clauses.title: The addition of not
clauses.text: 2.6 The addition of not more than 10 percent of the manufacturers own reworked material resulting from the manufacture of tanks only according to  this atandard is permissible.

clauses.title: Types and Features
clauses.text: 3   Types and Features a) Cylindrical vertical tanks b) Rectangules tanks

clauses.title: Finish
clauses.text: 4. Finish — The internal and external surface of the water storage tank shall be smooth, clean and free from other hidden internal defects, such as air bubbles, pits and mertallic or other foreign material inclusions.

clauses.title: Performance Requirement
clauses.text: 5. Performance Requirement

clauses.title: Resistance to deformation – The difference
clauses.text: 5.1 Resistance to deformation - The difference between the circumferiential measurement shall not be greater than 2 percent of the original measurements for cylindrical vertical tanks.The difference between the longitudinal measurements shall not be greater than 3 percent of the original measurements, for rectangular loft tanks.

clauses.title: Resistance to Impact–The impact
clauses.text: 5.2 Resistance to Impact-The impact shall neither result into cracking nor puncture of the tank.

clauses.title: Test for Load Resistance
clauses.text: 5.3 Test for Load Resistance —After removal of  the load the test specimen shall  be inspected  for deformation or crack on the  surface and after 4 hours of the  removal of the load the flat surface shall return to position.This test shall be applied to tanks with capacity 1500 litres and more.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength
clauses.text: 5.4 Tensile Strength — Shall not be less than 12 N/mm 2.

clauses.title: Flexural Modulus
clauses.text: 5.5 Flexural Modulus — Shall not be less than 300 N/ mm2.

clauses.title: Overall Migration
clauses.text: 5.6 Overall Migration — As specified in IS 10146 :1982*

clauses.title: Man
clauses.text: 6. Man-Hole, Hand-Hole Lids

clauses.title: Man
clauses.text: 6.1 Man-hole hand-hole lids shall be moulded from polyolefins of moinimum thickness 3 mm and shallhave sufficient ribs to provide adequate stiffness.  It shall be stabilized with 2 to ? percent of carbon black having satisfactory dispersions.

clauses.title: The lid shall fit
clauses.text: 6.2 The lid shall fit securely over the top rim of the tank and it shall rest evenly on it in  order to prevent the ingress of foreign matter such as insects, mosquitoes or dust through the top of the tank.  The lid shall also be provided with suitable locking arrangenment .

clauses.title: To test the lid
clauses.text: 6.3 To test the lid being fit securely to the manhole, no clearance in it should permit a 1.6 mm diameter wire to pass through. *Polyethylene for its safe use in contact with Food stuffs, phaunaceuticals and drinking water.
